notes: 30 days at a constant daily rate; not a growth forecast.
415000/day models 50 times the initial 8300 production rows arriving each day.
30300/day models 50 times the observed 606 combined daily events; user growth may exceed this.
Storage uses serialized wire size as a conservative proxy; BigQuery logical storage differs. Month-end size is charged for a whole month here; actual initial-month average is lower.
Storage grows with retained history. A 90-day or 400-day retention policy is not currently applied because first-ever cohort/identity facts must be preserved.
Queries are additional at catalogue analysis rate after available free allowances. 10 MiB minimum billing per table/query, cache, per-query caps and approximate project quota matter.
Excludes Cloud Run request overhead, monitoring/alert charges, failed-message retries, retention/backlog charges, taxes and shared free-allowance usage.
This is not a promise of a free service or a hard total-cost cap.
